retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, desaturated collage featuring a central dominant portrait surrounded by a dense mosaic of lifestyle imagery with integrated metallic 3D lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, desaturated composition centered on a large-scale portrait of a man with crossed arms. The background is a dense, low-opacity collage of smaller photographs depicting urban life, money, and candid moments. The entire image is unified by a heavy grain, distressed borders, and a monochromatic sepia-tinted black and white palette. Text is rendered as if embossed or tattooed in a 3D metallic style across the subject's forearms.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the foreground against a busy background mosaic
High-contrast lighting on the central figure creates depth against the darker collage
Metallic text texture mimics the jewelry worn by the subject
Distressed border frames the chaotic internal elements
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and distressed texture overlay
Central subject with crossed arms as the primary anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait occupying the middle 60% of the frame, from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright metallic jewelry/text on the forearms.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the crossed arms and metallic text, then radiates outward to the background collage elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded and dense.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark grays providing the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites and highlights on the face, jewelry, and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle warm sepia or desaturated gold tint in the highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation with high value contrast between shadows and highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Inner glow and drop shadow to create an embossed effect
Curved baseline to follow the anatomy of the forearms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to appear as if they are physically resting on the skin of the arms.

composition.rotation: Slightly angled to match arm orientation

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single strong display face integrated into the photography.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif skeleton that handles 3D beveling well.
High contrast serifs for a more elegant but aggressive look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast, desaturated monochrome collage of urban lifestyle photos (money, street scenes, portraits). Place a large, detailed portrait of a man with crossed arms in the center. Apply a heavy film grain and distressed border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold serif text across the forearms using a 3D metallic bevel effect. Warp the text to follow the curve of the arms and apply inner shadows to make it look embossed into the skin.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly desaturated/monochrome?
Does the text have a convincing 3D metallic texture?
Is the background collage visible but lower in contrast than the main subject?
Is there a distressed, grainy texture across the whole image?

adjustableVariables: Amount of film grain and distress
Thickness of the metallic bevel on the text

avoid: Floating text that doesn't interact with the lighting

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text appears 'on' the arms rather than just floating above them.
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the facial features of the main subject.
Verify the border looks like distressed film or paper.
Confirm the collage elements are varied and not repetitive.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Portrait + Background Photo Mosaic + High Contrast Monochrome + Metallic 3D Text Overlay + Distressed Texture
